description: Visual npm scripts manager for VSCode and any VSCode-based editor: scan all npm projects in the workspace, run scripts with one click, automatically track every listening port/service of the script, kill or restart a single service by port, and detect scripts started outside the editor (other IDEs / terminals) (VSCode, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.)
